mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId FROM UI_USER_EMAIL WHERE USER_EMAIL = #{authEmail} LIMIT 1
SELECT USER_ID AS userId FROM AGENT_MGMT WHERE AGENT_ID = #{agentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: INSERT INTO AGENT_MGMT (AGENT_ID, CLIENT_IP, LAST_STATUS_DT, USER_ID, STATUS) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{clientIp}, NOW(), #{userId}, 'Y') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CLIENT_IP = #{clientIp}, LAST_STATUS_DT = NOW(), USER_ID = #{userId}, STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS UNREGISTERED FROM UI_USERS A LEFT JOIN AGENT_MGMT B ON (A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID) WHERE B.AGENT_ID IS NULL ) AS UNREGISTERED, ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS ACTIVE FROM AGENT_MGMT WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ) AS ACTIVE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS INACTIVE FROM AGENT_MGMT WHERE STATUS = 'N' ) AS INACTIVE

SELECT B.AGENT_ID AS agentId, B.CLIENT_IP AS clientIp, B.LAST_STATUS_DT AS lastLoginDt, A.USER_ID AS userId, B.STATUS AS status, A.USER_NM AS userNm, (SELECT USER_EMAIL FROM UI_USER_EMAIL AS B WHERE A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID) AS userEmail, (SELECT CONM FROM UI_CO C WHERE A.COCD = C.COCD) AS coNm, (SELECT DEPTNM FROM UI_DEPT D WHERE A.DEPTCD = D.DEPTCD) AS deptNm, (SELECT JIKGUBNM FROM UI_JIKGUB J WHERE A.JIKGUBCD = J.JIKGUBCD) AS jikgubNm FROM UI_USERS A LEFT JOIN AGENT_MGMT B ON (A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID) WHERE 1=1
AND ( B.AGENT_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agentId}, '%') OR A.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agentId}, '%') )
AND B.AGENT_ID IS NULL
AND B.STATUS = #{status}
ORDER BY A.USER_NM, B.STATUS DESC, B.AGENT_ID

SELECT AGENT_ID AS agentId, CLIENT_IP AS clientIp, LAST_STATUS_DT AS lastLoginDt, USER_ID AS userId, (SELECT USER_NM FROM UI_USERS AS B WHERE A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID) AS userNm, (SELECT DEPTNM FROM UI_USERS B, UI_DEPT C WHERE B.DEPTCD = C.DEPTCD AND B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS deptNm FROM AGENT_MGMT AS A WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, LAST_STATUS_DT, NOW()) > 60 AND STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE AGENT_MGMT SET STATUS = CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, LAST_STATUS_DT, NOW()) > 60 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END WHERE LAST_STATUS_DT IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT AGENT_ID AS agentId, CONF_ID AS confId, CONF_NAME AS confName, CONF_VAL AS confVal, CATEGORY AS category FROM AGENT_POLICY WHERE AGENT_ID = 'DEFAULT'
AND CATEGORY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
ORDER BY CATEGORY, CONF_ID

SELECT #{agentId} AS agentId, A.CONF_ID AS confId, A.CONF_NAME AS confName, IF(B.AGENT_ID IS NULL, A.CONF_VAL, B.CONF_VAL) AS confVal FROM AGENT_POLICY A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AGENT_ID, CONF_ID, CONF_NAME, CONF_VAL FROM AGENT_POLICY WHERE AGENT_ID = #{agentId} ) B ON (A.CONF_ID = B.CONF_ID) WHERE A.AGENT_ID = 'DEFAULT' AND A.CONF_ID != 'proxy.pacUrl' UNION SELECT #{agentId} AS agentId, 'proxy.pacUrl' AS confId, NULL AS confName, CONCAT(CONF_VAL, '/agent/${agentId}/xcurenet.pac') AS confVal FROM AGENT_POLICY WHERE CONF_ID = 'policy.serverUrl'
mapper.update: INSERT INTO AGENT_POLICY (AGENT_ID, CONF_ID, CONF_VAL) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{confId}, #{confVal} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CONF_VAL = #{confVal}
mapper.select:
SELECT LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 1) AS groupCd, A.SERVICENM_LV1 AS groupNm, LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3) AS serviceCd, A.SERVICENM_LV2 AS serviceNm, IFNULL(B.LOGGING_YN, 'N') AS loggingYn FROM UI_SERVICE A LEFT JOIN AGENT_SERVICE_POLICY B ON (LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 1) = B.SERVICECD ) WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND ( LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR A.SERVICENM_LV2 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
GROUP BY LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 1), A.SERVICENM_LV1, LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3), A.SERVICENM_LV2 ORDER BY MAX(A.SORT)
mapper.update: INSERT INTO AGENT_SERVICE_POLICY (SERVICECD, LOGGING_YN) VALUES (#{serviceCd}, #{loggingYn} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE LOGGING_YN = #{loggingYn}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT CONF_VAL FROM EMASSAI.AGENT_POLICY WHERE AGENT_ID = 'DEFAULT' AND CONF_ID = 'mitm.options.listen_host') AS host, (SELECT CONF_VAL FROM EMASSAI.AGENT_POLICY WHERE AGENT_ID = 'DEFAULT' AND CONF_ID = 'mitm.port') AS port
SELECT HOST FROM AGENT_SERVICE_POLICY A, AGENT_SERVICE B WHERE A.LOGGING_YN = 'Y' AND A.SERVICECD = B.SERVICECD
